name: Craft Docs
tagline: Craft is a premium document editor for Mac, iPad, and iPhone with a polished design and powerful AI features. Its AI assistant can write, rewrite, summarise, and translate content directly within documents. Craft supports deep linking between notes, backlinks, and offline-first storage.
